one_liner_zh: 通用汽車 EPS 3.70 美元大超預期40%，但營收年減0.9%，成本控管與北美獲利支撐獲利、營收動能轉弱。
one_liner_en: GM crushed EPS at $3.70 by 40% but revenue dipped 0.9%, with cost control and North America profits offsetting weaker top line.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 大超預期 40.19%，惟營收年減 0.90%，獲利韌性勝於成長。
ai_view_zh: 訊號喜憂參半：EPS 大超預期主因成本紀律、定價韌性與回購，但營收轉為小幅衰退，凸顯銷量與定價的成長動能正在減弱。短期獲利驚喜或推升股價，惟市場將關注獲利品質是否依賴一次性因素。中期追蹤北美利潤率、電動車虧損收斂、關稅影響與資本配置（回購節奏）。週期性與30倍本益比為估值風險。
ai_view_en: Mixed signal: the large EPS beat stems from cost discipline, pricing resilience and buybacks, but revenue turned slightly negative, highlighting fading volume/pricing momentum. Near term the earnings surprise may lift the stock, though the market will question whether the beat relied on one-off factors. Mid term, track North America margins, narrowing EV losses, tariff impact and capital allocation. Cyclicality and a ~30x P/E are valuation risks.
highlights_zh: EPS 3.70 美元，大超預期 40.19%，成本控管與庫存定價優異
北美燃油車與卡車獲利能力維持強勁
庫藏股回購提升每股獲利
電動車與成本結構持續優化
highlights_en: EPS of $3.70 beat by 40.19% on strong cost control and pricing
North America ICE and truck profitability remains strong
Share buybacks boost earnings per share
risks_zh: 營收年減 0.9%，銷量與定價成長動能轉弱
電動車業務虧損與轉型投資壓力
關稅、利率與消費需求對汽車景氣的衝擊
本益比約30倍，對週期性車廠偏高
risks_en: Revenue down 0.9%, signaling weaker volume/pricing momentum
EV losses and transition investment pressure
Tariffs, rates and consumer demand weigh on the auto cycle
P/E of ~30x is elevated for a cyclical automaker
